items: *Helen:* What are you going to do now?
*Helen:* Because I’m going to a travel agency to make a reservation. Would you like to come with me?
*Danny:* Yes, of course. Are you going to take a trip?
*Helen:* Yes, I’ll go to Washington D.C. Have you *ever* been there?
*Helen:* Oh! I see. I haven’t been downtown yet. Don’t you get excited about going with me?
*Danny:* Yes, sure. That’s a wonderful idea!

blocks.text: Washington is a beautiful city. It’s the capital of the United States of America. Many people visit this city to take pictures, for shopping, to spend vacations or to discover some places.

items: – Helen was born in Washington, but she doesn’t know downtown, because she hasn’t been there.

– Helen has invited Danny to go there with her. In this opportunity she will show him some new places that Danny doesn’t know. He has *already* been there once, last year, but he hasn’t had enough time to visit interesting buildings, elegant shops, squares, and museums.
– Danny and Helen are happy to go there. They think it is a good chance to have a good time in that location of the U.S.A.
